name: Hex

components.m: the petrified eye of a newt

upcast.text: Concentration can last up to 4 hours with a level 2 slot, 8 hours with a level 3-4 slot and 24 hours with a level 5+ slot.

summary: Curse a creature: your attack hits deal it an extra 1d6 Necrotic, and it has Disadvantage on checks with one ability.
text: You lay a curse on a creature within range. Until the spell ends, whenever you hit it with an attack roll it takes an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage. Choose an ability when you cast the spell; the target has Disadvantage on ability checks made with that ability. If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before the spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action on a later turn to move the curse to a new creature. Concentration, up to 1 hour. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: your Concentration can last up to 4 hours with a level 2 slot, up to 8 hours with a level 3-4 slot, or up to 24 hours with a level 5+ slot.
